notes: PPIA-15 expands existing tester/reference/demo coverage; it must not duplicate already-sufficient scenarios merely to increase counts.
All authored scenarios and fixtures are synthetic/noncanonical QA material unless separately promoted by owning authority with source evidence.

Governed awkward-case scope includes simultaneous selection, mid-session reveals, entitlement loss, GM modifications, duplicate-name objects, version conflict, campaign-local override, source-only objects, vehicle transfer, relationship secret reveal, interrupted crafting, reconnect during approval, large inventories, dense creatures, unusual species, mobile-only, keyboard/accessibility and offline/read-only transitions.

PPIA-09 truth/belief/knowledge/reveal/provenance boundaries, PPIA-10 directional social/secret/permission boundaries, PPIA-11 uncertainty/no-guaranteed-balance boundaries and PPIA-14 permission/hidden-information/recovery microcopy boundaries remain authoritative inherited constraints.
P14-GAP-001 / inherited P13-GAP-001 remains an unresolved F024 Pack Lifecycle source gap; PPIA-15 tests must not invent missing Pack lifecycle behavior or expected results.
Permission/entitlement filtering precedes every test-visible derivative where protected state is involved; hidden and missing remain externally equivalent when existence is protected.
Offline/local state is not authoritative mutation; status-unknown is not failure; accepted durable Event is distinct from derived projection; blind ambiguous mutation retry remains forbidden.
Accessibility coverage requires semantic parity across mobile, keyboard, touch, screen-reader/nonvisual, high-zoom, reduced-motion and noncolor paths where applicable.
No application runtime activation, STAGE-A-A2 activation, release, deployment, tester access, paid service or production credential is authorized.
